title: Grow the VM 106 filesystem to fill the disk
runbook:
## Inputs needed

- `<PALWORLD_USER>` — the account inside VM 106 that has sudo (the operator logs in with it)

## Run this

```bash
ssh -o BatchMode=yes <PALWORLD_USER>@192.168.1.127 "sudo growpart /dev/sda 1"
```

```bash
ssh -o BatchMode=yes <PALWORLD_USER>@192.168.1.127 "sudo resize2fs /dev/sda1"
```

## Verify

- Root filesystem reports ~100GB: `ssh -o BatchMode=yes <PALWORLD_USER>@192.168.1.127 "df -h /"`

inputs.hint: the account inside VM 106 that has sudo (the operator logs in with it)
